headline: Dark Magician
title: Dark Magician Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Dark Magician. What is it? It is a Level seven DARK Spellcaster Normal Monster with two thousand five hundred attack. It is Yugi's signature card. What does it do? It has no effect. It is a solid attacker that a whole family of support cards is built around. How do you use it? Two Tributes summon it normally, so players search for help. Magician's Rod adds a Spell or Trap that lists Dark Magician when it is Normal Summoned, and Dark Magic Attack destroys all your opponent's Spells and Traps while you control Dark Magician.
